legend: A newborn girl with a sessile lobulated pink mass of the maxillary alveolar process measuring several centimetres in diameter. The mass interferes with feeding.

A well-circumscribed lesion beneath an attenuated epithelium that lacks rete ridges. An uninvolved zone of lamina propria separates the lesion from the epithelium. The lesion is composed of tightly packed polygonal cells with abundant granular cytoplasm. Nuclei are eccentric and dark-staining, with inconspicuous nucleoli and no evidence of mitotic activity. Thin-walled vessels are distributed throughout the lesion (inset).
